dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「じゃあ、今日から卒業パーティーの準備に入
　るけど、なるべく出席するんだよ」
dialogues.en:
"Okay then, we'll be starting the preparation for the
graduation party from now on, but try to come to school as
much as you can."
dialogues.text:
"Okay then, we'll be starting the preparation for the
graduation party from now on, but try to come to school as
much as you can."

dialogues.jp:
暦先生はそう言うと、出席簿片手に教室を出て
行く。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei took the roll, and left the classroom.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei took the roll, and left the classroom.

dialogues.jp: 「卒業パーティーか……」
dialogues.en: "A graduation party......"
dialogues.text: "A graduation party......"

dialogues.jp:
まったく、うちの学園も祭り好きだよな……ク
リスマスパーティーなんてのもあったし。
dialogues.en:
Our school really loves these kinds of events. I remember
having a Christmas party as well.
dialogues.text:
Our school really loves these kinds of events. I remember
having a Christmas party as well.

dialogues.jp:
なにも卒業式の後に、パーティーなんてしなく
てもいいのにな。
dialogues.en: Why should we have a party after the graduation ceremony?
dialogues.text: Why should we have a party after the graduation ceremony?

dialogues.jp:
（しかも、パーティーというより小さな学園
　祭）
dialogues.en: (And it's more like a school festival than a party.)
dialogues.text: (And it's more like a school festival than a party.)

dialogues.jp:
クラスや部活など関係なく、各人が好きな催し
物を企画できる。なんでもありの、創作発表の
場。
dialogues.en:
Each student can plan what they want to do regardless of
their class or club activities, and it's more like a place
to express their creativity.
dialogues.text:
Each student can plan what they want to do regardless of
their class or club activities, and it's more like a place
to express their creativity.

dialogues.jp:
しかも、催し物の企画に加わるかどうかは各人
の自由。なんの企画にも加わらず、純粋に客と
して参加することも出来る。
dialogues.en:
It's up to each student to come up with their stuff or you
can just show up as a guest and don't have to do anything.
dialogues.text:
It's up to each student to come up with their stuff or you
can just show up as a guest and don't have to do anything.

dialogues.jp:
こんな状況で進んで企画に参加するなんて、バ
カのすることだ。
dialogues.en:
I think you must be crazy to participate in this festival at
all.
dialogues.text:
I think you must be crazy to participate in this festival at
all.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「パーティーがどうした、朝倉」
dialogues.en: "What about the party, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "What about the party, Asakura?"

dialogues.jp:
やる気満々の顔をして、バカの頭領がやって来
る。
dialogues.en:
Here comes the head of the crazy people with high
motivation.
dialogues.text:
Here comes the head of the crazy people with high
motivation.

dialogues.jp: 「はりきってるな」
dialogues.en: "You seem to be highly motivated."
dialogues.text: "You seem to be highly motivated."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そう見えるか？」
dialogues.en: "You think?"
dialogues.text: "You think?"

dialogues.jp:
ニヤリと笑みを漏らすその表情は、誰が見ても、
腹黒さを感じるだろう。
dialogues.en:
I think anybody can see that he's up to no good in his
wicked smile.
dialogues.text:
I think anybody can see that he's up to no good in his
wicked smile.

dialogues.jp: 「また、何か｛・・／企画｝してるのか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you 'planning' something?"
dialogues.text: "Are you 'planning' something?"

dialogues.jp: いや、こいつがしてない訳ない。
dialogues.en: He has to be.
dialogues.text: He has to be.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「フ……付属最後を飾るに相応しいものを、現
　在進行中だ」
dialogues.en:
"Well...... we are in progress of something special to
celebrate the end of our school life."
dialogues.text:
"Well...... we are in progress of something special to
celebrate the end of our school life."

dialogues.jp: そうか、付属も遂に｛・・／最期｝を飾るのか……。
dialogues.en: Well, so our school life's coming to an "end."......
dialogues.text: Well, so our school life's coming to an "end."......

dialogues.jp: 「……捕まらんようにな」
dialogues.en: "......Don't get caught."
dialogues.text: "......Don't get caught."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「心配はいらん。脱出ルートは既に確保してあ
　るからな」
dialogues.en: "No need for worries. We've secured the escape route."
dialogues.text: "No need for worries. We've secured the escape route."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」
どんなルートかはしらんが、多分｛・・／ダメ｝だろう。
dialogues.en:
I don't know what kind of route, but I'm pretty sure it's a
no good one.
dialogues.text:
I don't know what kind of route, but I'm pretty sure it's a
no good one.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「おっと、そろそろ計画の第２段階に入らねば」
dialogues.en: "Oops, I have to set up the stage two of the plan soon."
dialogues.text: "Oops, I have to set up the stage two of the plan soon."

dialogues.jp: 教室を出て行く杉並を見送る。
dialogues.en: I see Suginami off as he walks out the class room.
dialogues.text: I see Suginami off as he walks out the class room.

dialogues.jp: ――さらば友よ。
dialogues.en: ----Goodbye friend.
dialogues.text: ----Goodbye friend.

dialogues.jp: 「さて……俺もそろそろ行くか」
dialogues.en: "Well...... should I go too?"
dialogues.text: "Well...... should I go too?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は席を立ち、大きく伸びをすると、鞄を片手
に教室の出口へと向かった。
dialogues.en:
I stood up, gave a big stretch, and walked toward the
entrance of the class room with a bag in my hand.
dialogues.text:
I stood up, gave a big stretch, and walked toward the
entrance of the class room with a bag in my hand.

dialogues.jp: ◆さらば友よ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Farewell friend◆
dialogues.text: ◆Farewell friend◆

dialogues.jp:
今日から卒パの準備期間に入る。企画に関して
は完全自由参加の卒パ。もちろん俺は参加しな
い予定だ。
dialogues.en:
We're starting the preparation for the graduation party.
It's not mandatory to participate in the party, so I'm not
participating.
dialogues.text:
We're starting the preparation for the graduation party.
It's not mandatory to participate in the party, so I'm not
participating.

dialogues.jp: もっとも、杉並はやる気まんまんのようだが。
dialogues.en: Although, Suginami seems to be willing to participate.
dialogues.text: Although, Suginami seems to be willing to participate.
